description: The owner's trust in an acceptance file over HTTP (plan task P5 pod-33, docs/PROOF-HUB-API.md), in a real Hub process.

mutations.name: HT-show
mutations.what: the file is not shown

mutations.name: HT-any-bytes
mutations.what: any sha256 can be trusted

mutations.name: HT-asked
mutations.what: what was asked for is trusted, not what is there

mutations.name: HT-invalid
mutations.what: a file that does not read can be trusted

mutations.name: HT-missing
mutations.what: a missing file is a changed one

mutations.name: HT-outside
mutations.what: a file outside the workspace is missing

mutations.name: HT-large
mutations.what: a file over its limit is read

mutations.name: HT-large-code
mutations.what: a file over its limit is missing

mutations.name: HT-file
mutations.what: a folder of that name is read
mutations.equivalent: a folder cannot be opened and read, so it is missing one step later

mutations.name: HT-keys
mutations.what: a body with more than the sha256 is taken

mutations.name: HT-hex
mutations.what: a sha256 in capitals, or none, is taken

mutations.name: HT-trusted
mutations.what: a trusted file is shown as not trusted

mutations.name: HT-untrusted
mutations.what: an untrusted file is shown as trusted

mutations.name: HT-invalid-shown
mutations.what: a file that does not read is shown as present

mutations.name: HT-query
mutations.what: the file takes any query

mutations.name: HT-rules
mutations.what: the masking rules take a part of a command out of what is shown

patches.old:
let text = value;
  for (const secret of secrets)
patches.new:
let text = maskSecrets(value);
  for (const secret of secrets)

import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import { maskSecrets } from '../permissions.mjs';

mutations.name: HT-mask
mutations.what: a registered secret in the file is shown

patches.old: const whole = withoutSecrets(fields, this.#secrets, seen, false);

mutations.name: HT-mask-flag
mutations.what: a command that is not shown whole does not say so

mutations.name: HT-mask-where
mutations.what: a command that is not shown whole is said of every text after it

mutations.name: HT-mask-all
mutations.what: the file does not say that a part of it is not shown whole

mutations.name: HT-mask-id
mutations.what: a registered secret in the name of a criterion is shown

mutations.name: HT-cwd
mutations.what: the folder of a check is not shown

mutations.name: HT-setup
mutations.what: the setup commands are not shown

mutations.name: HT-protected
mutations.what: what is protected is not shown

mutations.name: HT-manual
mutations.what: a manual criterion is shown without its note

mutations.name: HT-inspect
mutations.what: a manual criterion is shown without its paths

mutations.name: HT-repeat
mutations.what: how often a check runs is not shown

mutations.name: HT-revoke
mutations.what: a revoke removes nothing

mutations.name: HT-revoke-said
mutations.what: a revoke of nothing is said to be one

patches.old: return answer(200, { revoked, sha256: asked, trusted: false });
patches.new: return answer(200, { revoked: true, sha256: asked, trusted: false });

mutations.name: HT-route-get
mutations.what: the trust can be given by a GET

patches.new:
if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === TRUST_ROUTE) return send(await proofApi.trust(Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams)));
      if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/proof/acceptance') return

mutations.name: HT-public
mutations.what: the file is shown without the bearer

mutations.name: HT-companion
mutations.what: the Companion reads the file

mutations.name: HT-acp
mutations.what: the ACP agent may trust
